tools.name: decks.list_decks
tools.title: List decks
tools.description: The team's decks, most recently changed first, with slide counts. query finds words in titles and slides.

covers.description: Also return each deck's first slide and theme, to draw a cover

tools.name: decks.get_deck
tools.title: Open a deck
tools.description: A whole deck: title, theme, brand, linked records, and every slide with its layout, words, blocks and speaker notes. Use it before changing a deck you did not just make.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

tools.name: decks.get_slide
tools.title: Open a slide
tools.description: One slide: its layout, words, blocks (with their ids, to change one) and speaker notes.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

tools.name: decks.list_layouts
tools.title: Layouts and blocks
tools.description: Every slide layout (with the fields and block slots it has) and every block type (with its fields and an example). Read this once before building a deck.

tools.name: decks.list_themes
tools.title: Themes
tools.description: Every look a deck can have: the colour schemes (each with a light and dark mode), corners, faces, surfaces, density, ready presets, and the brand options (logo, accent colour, fonts).

tools.name: decks.list_comments
tools.title: Comments
tools.description: Comments on a deck (or on one slide), with replies, oldest first. Resolved ones are marked.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

tools.name: decks.list_activity
tools.title: What changed
tools.description: Recent changes to a deck (or to every deck when none is given): who did what, and whether it was a person or an AI app.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

tools.name: decks.get_changes
tools.title: Catch up
tools.description: The changes to a deck that a copy with this state vector has not seen, as a Yjs update. Editors use it after a dropped connection.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

state_vector.description: Base64 Yjs state vector; leave out for the whole deck

tools.name: decks.get_settings
tools.title: Settings
tools.description: You, your team, how this server signs people in and stores files, and your own preferences.

tools.name: decks.list_people
tools.title: People
tools.description: Everyone on the team and their role.

tools.name: decks.list_shares
tools.title: Share links
tools.description: The live view and embed links of a deck.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

tools.name: decks.preview_slide
tools.title: Look at a slide
tools.description: A picture (PNG) of one slide as it will look when presented, so you can check your work: text that runs over, a chart that reads badly, an image that does not load.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

tools.name: decks.create_deck
tools.title: New deck
tools.description: Make a deck. Give it a title, and optionally a theme, a brand and its slides all at once (or add slides after with decks.add_slide). Returns the deck with slide and block ids.

preset.description: A ready look: clean, ops, midnight, editorial, calm, garden, playful, war_room. Other options given with it override it.

scheme.description: Colour scheme: ops, midnight, neutral, ember, tide, sage, arcade, warroom

type.description: Faces: grotesk, mono, editorial (serif), humanist, pixel or system

surface.description: How cards sit: flat, bordered, elevated or glass

brand.description: logo, accent, on_accent, font, display, fonts_href, footer (see decks.list_themes)

layout.description: The layout: title, section, content, two_column, image_left, image_right, full_image, big_number, quote, closing, blank. decks.list_layouts explains each.

kicker.description: A small line above the title

slot.description: Where on the slide: main, or left and right on two_column

items.description: A block. t is one of text, heading, bullets, quote, stats, cards, table, chart, image, steps, timeline, checklist, callout, chat, score, kv, button; its other fields depend on t (decks.list_layouts lists them). Example: { "t": "stats", "items": [{ "value": "38%", "label": "Growth" }] }

blocks.description: The slide's blocks, in order. Keep slides light: one to three blocks.

notes.description: Speaker notes: what to say, only the presenter sees them

url.description: An https address or a file url from decks.upload_file

position.description: Which part to keep in view, like "center top"

image.description: The picture for image_left, image_right and full_image layouts

bg.description: Background: default, alt (a card colour), accent, or inverse (the opposite mode)

hidden.description: Hidden slides are skipped when presenting and exporting

from_example.description: Start from an example deck (its id or title) instead of empty

tools.title: Rename a deck

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

tools.name: decks.duplicate_deck
tools.title: Duplicate a deck
tools.description: Copy a whole deck, slides, theme and notes, under a new title. Comments and share links stay with the original.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

tools.title: Archive a deck
tools.description: Put a deck away (archived: true) or bring it back (archived: false). Archived decks keep their share links.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

tools.description: Write a slide's speaker notes: what to say. Only the presenter sees them (in presenter view and in the PowerPoint file).

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

tools.title: Duplicate a slide
tools.description: Copy a slide, words, blocks and notes, and put the copy right after it.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

tools.name: decks.reorder_slides
tools.title: Move slides
tools.description: Move one slide to a new position (slide and to), or put every slide in a new order (order: all slide ids or numbers, first to last).

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

to.description: The new position, 1 being the first

items.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

tools.name: decks.delete_slide
tools.title: Delete a slide
tools.description: Remove a slide from the deck.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

tools.name: decks.add_block
tools.title: Add a block
tools.description: Add one block to a slide: text, heading, bullets, quote, stats, cards, table, chart, image, steps, timeline, checklist, callout, chat (an agent answer), score, kv or button. decks.list_layouts lists each one's fields.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

slot.description: Where on the slide: main, or left and right on two_column

block.description: A block. t is one of text, heading, bullets, quote, stats, cards, table, chart, image, steps, timeline, checklist, callout, chat, score, kv, button; its other fields depend on t (decks.list_layouts lists them). Example: { "t": "stats", "items": [{ "value": "38%", "label": "Growth" }] }

at.description: Its position among the slide's blocks (default: last)

tools.name: decks.update_block
tools.title: Change a block
tools.description: Change some fields of one block, like its text, its items or a chart's numbers. The block keeps its type.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

block.description: A block on the slide: its id (b_...) or its number on the slide, 1 being the first

set.description: The fields to change, like { "text": "..." } or { "items": [...] }

tools.name: decks.move_block
tools.title: Move a block
tools.description: Move a block up or down on its slide (to a position), or into another slot (left or right on two-column slides).

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

block.description: A block on the slide: its id (b_...) or its number on the slide, 1 being the first

tools.name: decks.remove_block
tools.title: Remove a block
tools.description: Take one block off a slide.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

block.description: A block on the slide: its id (b_...) or its number on the slide, 1 being the first

tools.name: decks.add_image
tools.title: Add an image
tools.description: Put an image on a slide, by its https address or a file uploaded with decks.upload_file. as: block (default) adds an image block; slide sets the picture of an image_left, image_right or full_image slide (and switches a slide with another layout to image_right).

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

tools.name: decks.add_chart
tools.title: Add a chart
tools.description: Draw a chart on a slide from numbers: column (default), bar, line, area or donut. labels are the categories or dates; series are one or more named lists of numbers, one per label. One axis only: put measures of different size on different slides.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

tools.name: decks.upload_file
tools.title: Upload a file
tools.description: Upload an image (or a PowerPoint file to import) as base64. Returns its id and url, for decks.add_image, decks.set_brand logo, or decks.import_pptx. The screens stream files to /files/decks instead; this is the same thing for agents.

tools.name: decks.apply_theme
tools.title: Change the theme
tools.description: Change how the whole deck looks: a preset, or any of colour scheme, mode, corners, faces, surface and density. Every ui-design kit scheme and style is available; decks.list_themes lists them.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

preset.description: A ready look: clean, ops, midnight, editorial, calm, garden, playful, war_room. Other options given with it override it.

scheme.description: Colour scheme: ops, midnight, neutral, ember, tide, sage, arcade, warroom

type.description: Faces: grotesk, mono, editorial (serif), humanist, pixel or system

surface.description: How cards sit: flat, bordered, elevated or glass

tools.name: decks.set_brand
tools.title: Brand
tools.description: Put a brand over the theme: logo (image url), accent colour (#rrggbb), on_accent, font and display faces (CSS families), fonts_href (a Google Fonts stylesheet) and footer text. Give an empty string to clear one.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

tools.name: decks.apply_team_brand
tools.title: Use a team brand
tools.description: Put a warOnSaaS team's brand kit on the deck: its logo, accent colour, fonts and look (scheme, mode, faces, corners). team is the team's slug on account.waronsaas.com. Only on servers that use the warOnSaaS account.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

tools.name: decks.sync_doc
tools.title: Save typing
tools.description: Merge a Yjs update from an editor into the deck: what someone typed or changed in place. Agents use decks.set_slide_content and decks.update_block instead.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

tools.name: decks.set_preferences
tools.title: Your preferences
tools.description: Your own settings: the app's light or dark look (auto follows your device).

tools.name: decks.add_comment
tools.title: Comment
tools.description: Leave a comment on a slide (or on the deck), or reply to a comment with reply_to.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

slide.description: A slide: its id (s_...) or its number, 1 being the first

tools.name: decks.resolve_comment
tools.title: Resolve a comment
tools.description: Mark a comment as dealt with (resolved: true) or open it again (false).

tools.name: decks.delete_comment
tools.title: Delete a comment
tools.description: Delete your own comment (admins can delete anyone's).

tools.name: decks.share_deck
tools.title: Share a link
tools.description: Make a view-only link anyone can open without an account (kind: view), or an embed for a web page (kind: embed). Returns the link. Anyone with it can see the deck, so an app asks the person first.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

tools.name: decks.unshare_deck
tools.title: Turn off a link
tools.description: Turn off a share or embed link (or every link of the deck when none is named). People who open it see that it is gone.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

share.description: The share id; leave out to turn off every link

tools.name: decks.export_pdf
tools.title: Export as PDF
tools.description: Make a PDF of the deck, one page per slide (hidden slides left out). Returns a download link for the team. with_notes adds a page of speaker notes after each slide.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

tools.name: decks.export_pptx
tools.title: Export as PowerPoint
tools.description: Make a PowerPoint file (.pptx) of the deck that opens in PowerPoint, Keynote and Google Slides: real text boxes, tables and charts you can edit, images, and speaker notes. Returns a download link for the team.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

tools.name: decks.import_pptx
tools.title: Import PowerPoint
tools.description: Make a deck from a PowerPoint file uploaded with decks.upload_file. Best effort: titles, text, bullets, images, tables, simple charts and speaker notes come across, on the closest layout. The report says honestly what did not (animations, exact positions, shapes, SmartArt, video, custom fonts).

preset.description: A ready look: clean, ops, midnight, editorial, calm, garden, playful, war_room. Other options given with it override it.

scheme.description: Colour scheme: ops, midnight, neutral, ember, tide, sage, arcade, warroom

type.description: Faces: grotesk, mono, editorial (serif), humanist, pixel or system

surface.description: How cards sit: flat, bordered, elevated or glass

tools.name: decks.export_data
tools.title: Export everything
tools.description: Every deck of the team as JSON (slides, notes, theme, brand, comments, share links), plus a list of uploaded files. Returns a download link.

tools.name: decks.link_record
tools.title: Link to a CRM record
tools.description: Tie a deck to a CRM record, like the deal it is for. Inside the wOS suite the record is looked up in the CRM and a note with the deck's link is logged on it; on its own, give a label and url.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

record.description: The CRM record id, like d_acme01 for a deal

tools.name: decks.request_review
tools.title: Ask for a review
tools.description: Ask someone to review the deck. Inside the wOS suite this makes a task on the board (for a client, given to a person, with a due date) that links to the deck; on its own it is recorded on the deck and posted as a comment.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

client.description: The board client the task goes under (the suite's board needs one)

tools.name: decks.unlink_record
tools.title: Remove a link
tools.description: Remove a CRM or review link from a deck.

deck.description: A deck: its id (d_...) or its exact title

tools.name: decks.add_person
tools.title: Add someone
tools.description: Add a person to the team by email (and GitHub login if they use it). They can then sign in and edit every team deck.

tools.name: decks.remove_person
tools.title: Remove someone
tools.description: Take a person off the team. They are signed out everywhere; their decks and comments stay.

tools.name: decks.list_approvals
tools.title: Waiting for your yes
tools.description: Things an AI app asked to do that need your yes first (sharing a deck publicly, deleting a deck, removing someone).

tools.name: decks.decide_approval
tools.title: Approve or decline
tools.description: Say yes or no to something an AI app asked to do. Yes runs it as you. Only from the app, by a person.
